prompts.name: work-silver-v3
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single round achievement medal game UI PNG, work silver tier. Image 1 is only a STYLE AND EAGLE IDENTITY reference, not an edit target. Create a new front-facing circular sculpted commemorative coin featuring an eagle enthusiastically typing on a laptop on a desk, with a small round clock engraved behind its shoulder; mischievous proud eyebrows. Preserve the reference eagle's big rounded draped head with jagged feather collar, large rounded hooked beak, small rounded body and exaggerated lively expression. The eagle and every prop are PURE SILVER bas-relief carved in the same coin metal, not colored stickers. Brushed cool silver recesses and polished silver raised edges, realistic fine tooling texture, soft upper-left studio highlights. Match the reference's beaded circular rim and premium dimensional relief. Exactly one complete perfectly round coin nearly fills a square canvas, centered, full outer rim with 2 percent margin, straight-on orthographic, no perspective tilt. Genuine transparent background outside the coin. No text, no letters, no watermark, no unrelated animals, no colored eyes or colored objects. Distinct associated props must be clearly recognizable at a small UI size.
